title: Pharmaceuticals Laboratory
objective: Pharmaceutical sample workflows from creation through quality check
content: Pharmaceuticals Laboratory notebook with workflow pages for sample creation, QC, processing, testing, storage, reporting, and disposal.

pages.title: Sample Creation & Full Metadata Capture
pages.instructions: Create pharmaceutical samples with complete traceability from reception. Capture sample identity, material/category, core chemistry metadata, and any clinical context. System generates barcode/QR and sets status to Created - Pending QC.
pages.content: Sample Creation & Full Metadata Capture - Comprehensive pharmaceutical sample registration

pages.title: Raw Sample Quality Check (QC)
pages.instructions: Perform initial QC on pharmaceutical samples: check container integrity, label readability, visual appearance, volume/weight, and environmental condition deviations. Record pass/fail with remarks and move compliant samples forward.
pages.content: Raw Sample Quality Check (QC) - Assess condition, integrity, and readiness for further processing

criteria.label: Container/packaging intact (no cracks, leaks, or damage)
Label readable and matches request form
Visual appearance acceptable (no discoloration, precipitation, particulates)
Transport medium adequate and not expired

pages.title: Sample Processing & Aliquoting
pages.instructions: Prepare samples for downstream analytical assays. Perform weighing, grinding, homogenization, extraction/dissolution. Create aliquots with parent-child traceability, including unique aliquot IDs and barcode/QR labels.
pages.content: Sample Processing & Aliquoting - Sample preparation and aliquoting with parent-child traceability

pages.title: Assay & Test Execution
pages.instructions: Perform analytical testing with data integrity. Execute pharmaceutical assays (TLC, UV-Vis, FTIR, HPLC, titration, GC, LC-MS/MS), physical tests (dissolution, friability, hardness), and stability testing per ICH guidelines. Include positive/negative controls, internal standards, and replicates.
pages.content: Assay & Test Execution - Analytical testing with data integrity

pages.title: Storage & Inventory Management
pages.instructions: Assign samples to hierarchical storage (Room - Device - Rack - Box - Position). Set storage conditions per sample type: Pharmaceuticals (15-25C/2-8C/-20C), Biologicals (-80C/LN2), Microbiologicals (-80C stocks).
pages.content: Storage & Inventory Management - Storage hierarchies and environmental monitoring

pages.title: Reporting & Performance Monitoring
pages.instructions: Generate routine reports (intake logs, utilization, TAT) and track laboratory performance metrics (QC pass rates, assay success rates). View real-time dashboards and create external reporting summaries for collaborators, regulatory agencies, and surveillance networks.
pages.content: Reporting & Performance Monitoring - Comprehensive with QC parameters for Controls, Acceptance Criteria, and Deviation Management

pages.title: Disposal & Archiving
pages.instructions: Close sample lifecycle compliantly. Dispose samples based on criteria (expiry, exhaustion, failed QC, safety). Apply material-specific disposal methods (incineration for pharmaceuticals, autoclaving for biologicals). Archive raw data, final reports, and lineage for 5-10 years per GxP/GMP requirements.
pages.content: Disposal & Archiving - Compliant closure and long-term archival
